name: DP_1
structureNote: Openness lists the modules plugged in a rack as siblings of the rack or rail (Rack_0 / Rail_0 has childCount 0); positionNumber is the slot. Use deviceItemPath <module name> (e.g. DI_1) in TiaDeviceItem operations.
serverModuleNotice: ET 200SP station without server module (Openness does not add it): plug it behind the last module with TiaDeviceItem(plugNew) (typeIdentifier 'OrderNumber:6ES7 193-6PA00-0AA0', name 'Server module_1', positionNumber 1), and move it again with TiaDeviceItem(plugMove) when more modules follow.
